name: Jason Marsh
summary: Director of Technology with 13+ years across IT, assistive technology services, and team leadership. Builds production AI systems on the Anthropic API - conversational intake, agentic tool-calling, retrieval, and batch classification across a 7,500-product catalog - with a focus on accessibility for people with disabilities and older adults. ATACP-certified in assistive technology assessment.

projects.name: WhatCanHelp
projects.desc: (whatcanhelp.com) - assistive-technology product discovery platform, designed and built end-to-end: 7,500+ AI-classified products with conversational intake, shortlist/compare tools, and auto-generated funding-justification PDFs. Node/Express + SQLite (better-sqlite3), self-hosted behind Caddy/PM2; batch classification pipeline using prompt caching and the Batch API for cost efficiency, with schema-level guardrails against hallucinated product data.
